messages:
Nina Alvarez: Heads-up — multiple interviewers in today's panel said the scorecard they opened during the debrief was missing the behavioral rubric sections. They could only see 'technical' and freeform.
Tom Becker: saw 3 reports too. This happened right after we pushed the new scorecard template migration last night.
Rina Shah: oh no. Did the migration drop optional sections?
Elena Morales: quick check: the migration script maps old field ids to new ids. Looks like two field IDs for "collaboration" were renamed and not included in the mapping.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-734 19-03-08 scorecard-migration-missing-fields; assigned to eng-ml.
Nina Alvarez: real impact: interviewers couldn't rate 'cross-team collaboration' and some feedback was lost until we asked folks to edit later. That adds friction and hurts calibration.
Tom Becker: temporary workaround: ask interviewers to use the "freeform" section and prefix with [COLLAB] so we can retro-map them. Also recruiters can attach the old PDF as a reference during debrief.
Rina Shah: engineering fix: I'll patch the migration mapping and run a forward-fill job to add the missing fields to affected scorecards. Need a small maintenance window.
Elena Morales: product request: please add a validation step in the migration that flags unmapped field IDs and stops auto-merge. Also add a rollout note to interviewer-training so interviewers are aware when templates change.
Nina Alvarez: can we also add a quick alert in the ATS UI when a scorecard template changes, with a one-click preview? Many folks complained they didn't realize the template changed.
Rina Shah: noted. Plan: 1) emergency mapping patch + forward-fill (ETA: 4h) 2) migration validation + preview feature (ETA: next sprint) 3) ops note for recruiter playbook to ask interviewers to check required fields post-interview.
Tom Becker: I'll notify the interviewers affected and run the manual remap for today's cohort.
ops-bot: INC-2026-734 status -> in_progress.
Nina Alvarez: thanks team. Please post when the forward-fill is done so we can close the incident and update training docs.
